main_body: repeating ground terrain patch with fern/foliage texture
evidence: This is a flat repeating ground terrain tile patch (4x3 tiles, rows 0-47), which appropriately has a top surface covering all 48 rows and 0 front face rows.

style.evidence: The candidate ground patch uses 4 green shades plus a small ochre accent to depict repeating prehistoric fern-like foliage across each 16x16 tile. While slightly more repetitive as an identical 16x16 stamp compared to the varied grass tiles in the left reference, each individual tile has comparable pixel density, no near-black outlines, and no large flat fills.
